title: Create movement request
description: Payload for `POST /movements`. A consignmentNote is required when any waste item declares hazardous properties; the service checks that, as the rule spans the waste items and the consignment note.

producer.description: The producer of the waste. wasteSource picks which fields apply.

collectionDateTime.description: The planned time the waste will be collected, as an ISO 8601 date-time. The actual time is given when the Collection is recorded.

collectionSite.description: The place the waste will be collected from.

intendedCarriers.description: The carriers intended to transport the waste. At least one is required.

intendedReceivers.description: The intended receivers of the waste. At least one is required.

wasteItems.description: The items of waste in the Movement. At least one is required. Treatments are not accepted when creating a Movement.

treatments.description: Not accepted when creating a Movement yet

brokerOrDealer.description: Any broker or dealer involved in the Movement.

supportingReferences.description: References that help identify the Movement, such as a PO or job number.

specialHandlingRequirements.description: Handling instructions for the waste. Leave out when there are none.

consignmentNote.description: The hazardous waste consignment note. Required when any waste item declares hazardous properties.
